_about: Default limits used by scripts/page_speed.py. 'verified' is true only when the value was read in its source on the 'checked' date. ttfb_ms is remembered from an outside source, so it only warns: the script says it is unverified, and a limit the user passes with --budget-ttfb-ms is the real check. min_compress_bytes is mstack's own cut-off, not a claim about any standard, and is used as a check.

ttfb_ms.source: The upper edge of a 'good' time to first byte as remembered from web.dev guidance. Not read in the source during this work; read it there before quoting it.

min_compress_bytes.source: mstack's own choice, not taken from a standard. Below about one kilobyte compression saves little; text at or above it that arrives uncompressed is reported as a finding.
